response.justification: The candidate has extensive software development experience and strong proficiency in C, but lacks direct experience with Linux kernel modification, embedded networking, or security-specific technologies like MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, or switch chip knowledge. Their background is skewed toward web/mobile applications, AI tools, and general software development rather than embedded firmware or security features for network switches. While their C experience is notable, the absence of domain-specific skills and Japanese language proficiency (critical for this role) significantly reduces their fit.
strengths: Strong C programming experience across multiple domains (e.g., LabWindows/CVI, embedded tools, and system-level development)
Proven ability to work in diverse tech stacks (D, Java, TypeScript, Node.js, etc.) and learn new technologies quickly
Experience with Linux, Git, and software development best practices (TDD, CI/CD), demonstrating solid engineering fundamentals
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel modification, embedded networking, or security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)
Lacks industry experience in LAN-switch products or networking hardware, which is core to the role
Japanese language proficiency not mentioned in resume; English is fluent but no indication of Japanese ability
